# MustaFlow AI

> An AI-powered app builder for non-technical users. Describe an app idea in plain language and MustaFlow plans, builds, and deploys it — no coding required.

MustaFlow supports multiple output stacks: static HTML/CSS/JS sites, React SPAs, full-stack Node.js apps, and native mobile apps (Expo/React Native). The stack is auto-detected from the user's description.

## Product

- [Home](https://mustaflow.app/): Landing page and product overview
- [Pricing](https://mustaflow.app/pricing): Plans and credit pricing (Lite, Eco, Power, Pro modes)
- [Gallery](https://mustaflow.app/gallery): Template gallery — example apps users can start from
- [Extensions](https://mustaflow.app/extensions): Marketplace of integrations and add-ons
- [Community](https://mustaflow.app/community): Community hub and public project showcase

## Help & Documentation

- [Help Center](https://mustaflow.app/help): Getting started guides and how-to articles
- [Domains API](https://mustaflow.app/help/domains-api): Guide to connecting custom domains to published apps
- [Developer Docs](https://mustaflow.app/developers): API reference and developer integration guides
- [Developer Changelog](https://mustaflow.app/developers/changelog): API and platform release notes

## Trust & Legal

- [Trust & Security](https://mustaflow.app/trust): Security posture, encryption, GDPR readiness, SOC 2 status, and compliance contacts
